summary: Full backend + frontend e2e test of MiCells institutional site. All 7 backend pytest tests pass (health, enquiry create success, 3 validation cases, list ordering, no _id leak). Full Playwright flow passed: all 13 data-testid sections render, hero video autoplays, headline contains 'Biological Assurance' and 'Medical Certainty', all four nav links scroll to correct sections, contact form e2e succeeds (UI-submitted enquiry persisted to MongoDB and retrievable via GET /api/enquiries), validation toast appears on empty submit, mobile hamburger panel works, footer has mailto:info@micells.io and current year, no console errors, no forbidden temperature references (-150/-196/150°C/196°C), no visible Emergent branding (innerText clean, no visible emergent IDs, no emergent.sh links).
action_items: LAUNCH-BLOCKER (per spec literal interpretation): page outerHTML still contains the case-insensitive substring 'emergent' even though no Emergent branding is VISIBLE. Sources: (1) logo image, wordmark og:image, favicon and hero video src all point to https://customer-assets.emergentagent.com/... (4 separate URLs in DOM); (2) index.html <style> kill-switch comment literally reads 'Hard kill any Emergent residue' and selectors include #emergent-badge, [id*="emergent"], a[href*="emergent.sh"], a[href*="app.emergent"]. The kill-switch CSS itself injects the word into outerHTML. Mitigation: (a) re-host the 3 customer-assets URLs (logo mark, wordmark, hero MP4) on a non-emergent domain or proxy them via /public, (b) remove the literal 'Emergent' comment and rewrite the kill-switch selectors using attribute fragments that don't contain the full word (e.g. [id*="emerg"] still leaks — best is to remove the CSS entirely since index.html no longer loads any Emergent scripts, or move to runtime JS removal). If the user accepts a relaxed interpretation (only VISIBLE/RENDERED Emergent branding must be absent), the site already passes.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py line 60-64 uses `logger.info(...)` inside create_enquiry, but `logger` is defined at module load (line 94) AFTER the route is declared. This works only because the function body runs at request time, not import time — fragile pattern. Move logging.basicConfig + logger assignment to the top of the file (before route definitions) for clarity.
backend/server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to a lifespan context manager.

Contact.jsx — client-side guard checks `!form.name`, `!form.email`, `!form.message` but HTML `required` attributes on the inputs (`required={required}` on Field, `required` on textarea) will block submit before the JS toast ever fires in normal use. The toast only surfaces if the user bypasses browser validation (e.g. autofill removed). Consider removing one layer for clarity, or rely on server 422 + toast for unified UX.

brand.js — the logo/wordmark/hero video are hosted on customer-assets.emergentagent.com. This is the root cause of the 'emergent' string still being present in outerHTML. Re-host assets locally (frontend/public/) or on a neutral CDN.

Nav.jsx — NAV array has 'Infrastructure' (→ #technology) and 'Governance' (→ #governance). There is no section with id='governance' on the page (Framework.jsx has id='framework', Advisory has id='advisory'). The Governance nav link is therefore a dead anchor. Verify which section it should point to (likely #framework or #advisory).
Footer.jsx — Privacy Policy and Terms of Use anchors point to '#' (dead links). Either link to real pages or remove until ready.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional checks; 'zero emergent in outerHTML' fails only on hosting URLs + kill-switch CSS comment

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_*@example.com enquiries via POST /api/enquiries during pytest and via UI submit (Contact form). Marked with TEST_ prefix. No cleanup endpoint exists; consider adding admin delete or scripted teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers /api/health, POST /api/enquiries (success + 422 cases), GET /api/enquiries (ordering + _id exclusion). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. The single launch-blocker is the literal 'emergent' substring still present in outerHTML via (a) customer-assets.emergentagent.com asset URLs and (b) the index.html kill-switch CSS comment + selectors. Everything else is green.
rca of the issue: The spec mandates 'page DOM (innerText + outerHTML) MUST NOT contain the case-insensitive substring "emergent"'. The current build satisfies the innerText half but the outerHTML half is violated by: (1) 4 asset URLs (img src x2, video src, og:image meta, favicon link) that load from customer-assets.emergentagent.com — visible in outerHTML; (2) index.html embedded <style> block whose comment literally says 'Hard kill any Emergent residue' and whose selectors contain the literal token #emergent-badge, [id*="emergent" i], [class*="emergent" i], a[href*="emergent.sh" i], a[href*="app.emergent" i]. Reproduction: navigate to the site, run `document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase().includes('emergent')` in console → returns true. Mitigation: re-host the logo/wordmark/video on the public folder or a neutral domain, then either delete the kill-switch CSS entirely (no longer needed since no Emergent loaders are referenced from index.html) or rewrite without the literal word.
